name: Report to Captain Stoutfist
summary: After the fighting at Dun Algaz, Report to Captain Stoutfist sends proven fighters into Menethil Harbor's keep. The harbor is an Alliance military post, where Valstag Ironjaw directs you to Captain Stoutfist as the Dragonmaw threat spreads across the Wetlands.

sections.title: A Widening Threat
sections.body: Dwarven mountaineers have watched the narrow passes of Dun Algaz for years. The Dragonmaw clan's return reaches beyond Loch Modan, though, as the orcs push outward, raise encampments, and threaten the marshlands. Valstag Ironjaw knows that holding the pass is only the first step in protecting the road to Ironforge.

sections.title: The War Room of Menethil
sections.body: Captain Stoutfist oversees Menethil Harbor's defenses from the war room inside Menethil Keep. Dark Iron saboteurs, local beasts, and marsh murlocs all threaten the port, so the captain depends on capable volunteers to counter dangers beyond the walls. Valstag sends you to carry out direct orders against the Dragonmaw war machine.

faq.q: Who sends me to Captain Stoutfist?
faq.answer: Valstag Ironjaw, stationed in Menethil Keep in Menethil Harbor, sends you to Captain Stoutfist after you prove yourself in battle against the local Dragonmaw orcs.
Captain Stoutfist is inside Menethil Keep, in the western Wetlands town of Menethil Harbor. He stands over tactical maps in the keep's war room.

faq.q: Why are the Dragonmaw orcs a priority for Menethil Keep?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw hold ancient strongholds throughout the Wetlands and threaten the trade roads between Menethil Harbor and Ironforge. Their forces are pressing beyond Dun Algaz, and the garrison cannot ignore their growing encampments.

faq.q: What happens after reporting to Captain Stoutfist?
faq.answer: After you report to Captain Stoutfist, he enlists you in the offensive against the Dragonmaw. He sends you to their encampments to strike down their war banners in the marsh.

faq.q: Who are the Dragonmaw orcs in the Wetlands?
faq.answer: The Dragonmaw are remnants of the old Horde who enslaved red dragons at Grim Batol during the Second War. Grim Batol was broken, but surviving warbands remain entrenched across the marshlands, raiding travelers and defying Alliance authority.

faq.q: Why is Menethil Harbor stretched so thin?
faq.answer: Menethil Harbor faces constant threats from marsh wildlife, encroaching murlocs, and hostile Dark Iron dwarves trying to undermine the port. With garrison forces defending the walls and docks, Captain Stoutfist relies on outside champions to strike distant orc outposts.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know that defending the trade line between Menethil Harbor and Ironforge's gates is vital to Khaz Modan's security.
As an Alliance member, you know Menethil Harbor is the primary gateway for goods and reinforcements between the southern kingdoms and Khaz Modan. Orc raids on the road would cripple Alliance trade.
As a warrior, you bring the raw combat prowess Valstag Ironjaw seeks when he sends seasoned front-line fighters to Captain Stoutfist's command.
